qa_pairs.question: Which component is labeled as number 1 in the assembly drawing?
qa_pairs.answer: Component number 1 is the first gear.

qa_pairs.question: What does callout number 6 identify in this transmission cross-section?
qa_pairs.answer: Callout number 6 identifies the input shaft.

qa_pairs.question: Where is the reverse gear located in relation to the other forward gears?
qa_pairs.answer: The reverse gear (marked as R) is positioned between the first gear and fifth gear on the upper gear cluster.

qa_pairs.question: What component is shown at the bottom of the transmission case as number 8?
qa_pairs.answer: Component number 8 is the layshaft, located at the bottom of the transmission case.

qa_pairs.question: How many forward gear positions are labeled in this transmission diagram?
qa_pairs.answer: There are five forward gear positions labeled: first gear (1), second gear (2), third gear (3), fourth gear (4), and fifth gear (5).

qa_pairs.question: What is the relationship between the input shaft and output shaft in this assembly?
qa_pairs.answer: The input shaft (6) is positioned at the top/front of the transmission, while the output shaft (7) extends from the rear of the transmission case, with the gear clusters arranged between them.

qa_pairs.question: Which page number is this diagram found on in the service manual?
qa_pairs.answer: This diagram is found on page 23-101 of the service manual.
